title: Gravitee OTel · API Drill-down
description: Everything about one API: health, status codes, latency, consumers, and the individual failed or slow calls, down to their traces and payloads.

links.title: Call logs of this API
links.tooltip: Payloads of this API's logged calls

targets.expr: clamp_min(sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) / sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) - sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_sum{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])) / sum (rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_count{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_CLIENT", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range])), 0)

panels.title: Rejections by reason (failure key)
panels.description: Calls a policy refused or failed, by Gravitee failure key (RATE_LIMIT_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, QUOTA_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS…). Calls refused by plan security (no or invalid key) have no failure key: see the 401/403 counts.

panels.title: Backend calls by status
panels.description: What the backend answered (the Gateway's client spans).

panels.title: Response time distribution
panels.description: Calls per response-time bucket (the span histogram's buckets). Bands reveal bimodal behaviour: cache hits vs misses, fast vs slow backends.

panels.title: Applications
panels.description: One line per application: volume, quality of service received, breadth of API usage, rate-limit pressure. '(keyless / rejected)' groups keyless plans and calls rejected before an application was identified.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, application) (label_replace(label_replace(rate(gravitee_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range]), "application", "$1", "gravitee_application_name", "(.+)"), "application", "(keyless / rejected)", "gravitee_application_name", "")))

count by (application) (sum by (application, gravitee_api_name) (label_replace(label_replace(increase(gravitee_calls_total{span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER", gravitee_api_name=~"$api"}[$__range]), "application", "$1", "gravitee_application_name", "(.+)"), "application", "(keyless / rejected)", "gravitee_application_name", "")) > 0)

panels.title: Calls by plan
panels.description: Plans are identified by their flow (spans carry no plan id), so a plan without a flow isn't counted. The name is the flow's name.

panels.title: Latest failed calls (4xx/5xx)
panels.description: Click a trace to open its spans (phases, plan flow, each policy, the backend call) and its logged payloads.

panels.title: Latest slow calls (> 500 ms)
panels.description: Click a trace to open its spans (phases, plan flow, each policy, the backend call) and its logged payloads.

panels.title: Logged failed calls
panels.description: Failed calls of this API with OTel logs. Click a request id for its payloads, or a trace for its spans. Empty when OTel logs aren't enabled on the API.
